title: Yellow Garlic Filipino Noodles Pancit Canton
description: A garlicky and springy Filipino dish featuring Greek yogurt, perfect for a hangover cure, this pancit canton recipe is a twist on the classic with a double fry method inspired by KFC, making it a dash friendly meal option.
instructions: Heat 1 cup of vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.

Double fry the pancit canton noodles by first frying them for 2 minutes, then removing them from the oil and letting them cool for 5 minutes, and finally frying them again for an additional 2 minutes until golden brown.
Remove the noodles from the oil and place them on a paper towel lined plate to drain excess oil.
In a large pan, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium heat and saute the minced garlic until fragrant.
Add the soy sauce, oyster sauce, salt, and black pepper to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the Greek yogurt to the pan and stir to combine, cooking for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the double fried noodles to the pan and stir to combine with the yogurt sauce.
Transfer the noodles to a serving platter and top with chopped scallions and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Serve the pancit canton hot with lemon wedges on the side.
